policies.title: Universal Import Tariffs 2025
policies.promise_text: Impose tariffs to bring manufacturing jobs back and make American products cheaper
policies.summary: 10-20% tariffs on all imports, with 60% on Chinese goods. Resulted in higher consumer prices, job losses in manufacturing, and retaliatory tariffs.
policies.what_was_promised: I will impose tariffs to bring manufacturing jobs back to America and make American products cheaper. We'll bring factories back and prices will go down.
what_actually_happened: Consumer prices increased 12.3% on affected goods
~47,000 jobs lost due to retaliatory tariffs
Manufacturing output declined 3.2%
Trade deficit grew by $45B annually
Average household costs increased $540/year

expert_analyses.summary: The proposed tariffs are projected to reduce GDP by 0.2% and increase consumer costs by an average of $540 per household annually.
Tariff policy shows net negative impact on employment with manufacturing job losses outpacing gains in protected industries.

timeline.description: Initial 10% tariffs on all imports implemented

timeline.title: Consumer Price Impact Measured
timeline.description: CPI shows 12.3% increase on affected consumer goods

policies.title: Infrastructure Modernization Act
policies.promise_text: Rebuild America's infrastructure with the biggest investment in generations
policies.summary: $500B infrastructure package focusing on roads, bridges, broadband, and public transit. Creating jobs and improving connectivity.
policies.what_was_promised: We will rebuild America's crumbling infrastructure - roads, bridges, airports, broadband - with the biggest investment in generations.
what_actually_happened: 280,000 jobs created in construction and engineering
15,000 miles of roads repaired or upgraded
Broadband access extended to 8 million rural households
Public transit improvements in 45 metro areas
GDP boost estimated at 1.2% over 5 years

expert_analyses.summary: Infrastructure investment shows positive ROI with job creation and long-term economic benefits outweighing costs.

timeline.title: Bill Signed into Law
timeline.description: Infrastructure Modernization Act passes with bipartisan support

timeline.title: Funding Allocated
timeline.description: Federal grants distributed to states for project planning

timeline.title: Projects Begin
timeline.description: Major infrastructure projects break ground nationwide

policies.title: Mass Deportation Initiative
policies.promise_text: Launch the largest deportation program in American history
policies.summary: Expanded immigration enforcement targeting undocumented immigrants. Significant economic disruption in agriculture and construction sectors, family separations.
policies.what_was_promised: We will launch the largest deportation program in American history to remove criminal illegal aliens and restore law and order.
what_actually_happened: ~150,000 deportations (first 90 days)
Agricultural labor shortage causing $8B in crop losses
Construction sector facing 12% labor shortage
12,000+ families separated (including US citizen children)
Legal challenges in 15 states
ICE detention center capacity exceeded by 35%

expert_analyses.summary: Mass deportations create economic disruption, labor shortages, and humanitarian concerns without addressing root causes of immigration.

timeline.title: Agricultural Crisis
timeline.description: Farm industry reports critical labor shortages

policies.title: School Choice Expansion Act
policies.promise_text: Give parents school choice and break the public school monopoly
policies.summary: Federal voucher program for private and charter schools. Mixed outcomes: increased options for some, concerns about public school funding erosion.
policies.what_was_promised: Every parent will have the right to send their child to the school of their choice - public, private, charter, or religious.
what_actually_happened: 15% of eligible families used vouchers
Public schools in 20 districts faced funding cuts
Private school enrollment up 8%
Rural areas saw limited new school options
Achievement gaps widened in some districts
Charter school quality varied significantly

expert_analyses.summary: School choice programs show mixed results - benefits concentrated in suburban areas, potential harm to underfunded public schools.

timeline.title: Bill Signed
timeline.description: School Choice Expansion Act becomes law

timeline.title: Program Launch
timeline.description: Voucher program begins for 2025-26 school year
